відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"The burgundy heeled shoes and the burgundy bag echo each other, and the graphite coat keeps everything calm around them. Together they let the fuchsia skirt be the one loud note. You asked to stand out, and this does it boldly without a second competing colour: a soft grey top, a deep graphite coat, and one bright skirt. For a cold, windy autumn evening with rain, the coat with its hood does the practical work, and the heels keep the outfit dressed for dinner after the film. I chose heels even in a downpour because you will mostly be seated at the cinema and the restaurant, so the evening look matters more than the walk between them. The relaxed coat falls in one straight line, and the heels lengthen the line of your legs below the hem, so the eye travels down to the skirt and the shoes.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Raise the collar of the graphite coat against the wind: it adds a vertical line near your face and sharpens the silhouette.\",\"Pull up the hood of the graphite coat in the downpour and lower it once you are inside.\",\"Leave the graphite coat open at the cinema and at dinner so the fuchsia skirt stays the focus, with the quiet burgundy bag and shoes beneath it.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#20·04\",\"what\":\"graphite hooded coat\"},{\"n\":\"#401·10\",\"what\":\"fuchsia skirt\"},{\"n\":\"#92·23\",\"what\":\"grey top\"},{\"n\":\"#93·22\",\"what\":\"burgundy heeled shoes\"},{\"n\":\"#115·43\",\"what\":\"burgundy bag\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#92·23\",\"text\":\"A top in a soft, cool grey with a quiet, even tone that keeps the upper half calm.\"},{\"n\":\"#401·10\",\"text\":\"A skirt in vivid fuchsia, the brightest note of the outfit and the piece that makes you stand out.\"},{\"n\":\"#20·04\",\"text\":\"A relaxed graphite coat with set-in sleeves and a hood, falling loosely and straight, with a collar that can be raised.\"},{\"n\":\"#93·22\",\"text\":\"Burgundy dress shoes with a heel, deep in colour and dressed enough for an evening out.\"},{\"n\":\"#115·43\",\"text\":\"A burgundy bag in a rich, dark tone that stays quiet beside the bright skirt.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":7168,"output_tokens":1892},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
